description: This Java source file defines the 'HealthCheckHook' class which implements a Cucumber @Before hook to perform environment health checks before executing test scenarios. It manages environment classification, caching results, logging, and failure handling based on environment state.

classes.name: HealthCheckHook.EnvironmentNotReadyException

classes.name: HealthCheckHook
classes.description: Implements Cucumber @Before hook to ensure environment health before scenarios.
